game.q: the whisper never says “disobey.” so what does it say?

wrong.yolo: too blunt. a whisper never says it straight.
wrong.bite: close, but the real pitch was bigger.

game.right: YES. he renamed it the tree of forever. nobody reaches for “disobey.” plenty reach for “forever.”

end.line: a whisper renamed a tree, and the qur’an named the whisper so you can too.
